o.text: From Arabic حَرَكَة (ḥaraka), whence also hərəkat ("political etc. movement").
Borrowed from Classical Persian انتخابات (intixābāt), plural of انتخاب (intixāb), ultimately from Arabic اِنْتِخَاب (intiḵāb).
From Russian си́мвол (símvol), ultimately from Ancient Greek σύμβολον (súmbolon).
Calque of Russian пла́вленый сыр (plávlenyj syr).
Borrowed from Arabic سَلْجُوقِيّ (saljūqiyy). By surface analysis, Səlcuq + -i.

o.text: Borrowed from Russian навигация (navigacija), from Latin navigatio.
dinlə- + -mə. Most senses developed either as a calque or as a semantic loan from Russian слушание (slušanije), выслушивание (vyslušivanije) or прослушивание (proslušivanije).
